Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Deposit Hold
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 2 pool
Unique.
Put this card in play with 6 counters. During your influence phase, you get 1 less transfer and you must move 1 counter from this card to an uncontrolled minion you control or burn this card.
